description.html: This is an electronic fixture for a single 14 W T5 fluorescent tube, made by Mubang International Lighting, model MB-DZ14W. The packaging describes it as an integrated T5 fixture for one 14 W tube, which means the electronic ballast is built into the fixture body and no separate unit is needed.

T5 tubes are slim (16 mm) and give plenty of light with low power use, so they are a common choice for daytime lighting in terrariums and planted vivariums. The fixture is practical to mount under a lid or on top of the terrarium.

The fixture only works with 14 W T5 tubes, so check that your tube matches that wattage and length before buying. Before ordering, check with us whether you also need a tube. If you need UVB, choose a UVB tube of the right wattage and length for this fixture, or call us to check compatibility.

Do not install the fixture where the animal can reach it or where it will be sprayed with water. Call us before ordering for exact dimensions and a tube recommendation, and see other lighting in our equipment range.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
